title: Dhanteras: Dates, Gold Buying, and Sending Money to India
summary: Diwali 2026 falls on November 8, with Dhanteras on November 6. Learn key dates, gold-buying traditions, and how to time transfers to India.
body_markdown:
***Quick answer:** Diwali falls on November 8, 2026, but the season’s shopping, travel, and money-sending activity picks up in late October. Dhanteras, observed on November 6, 2026, is the most auspicious day of the year for buying gold, silver, and household items. Because banks in India often have limited hours or full closures around these dates, sending money early is the safest way to make sure funds arrive in time for the celebrations.*


**For millions of families across the United States with ties to India, the weeks before Diwali are some of the busiest of the year. Gifts get purchased, flights get booked, and money gets sent home to relatives preparing for one of India’s most significant celebrations. If you’re planning ahead for Diwali 2026, understanding the timeline—and how it affects everyday tasks like international money transfers—can save you from last-minute stress.**


**This guide breaks down the key dates for Dhanteras and Diwali in 2026, explains why gold buying plays such a central role in the festivities, and covers what you need to know about Indian bank schedules during this period.**


## When Are Dhanteras and Diwali in 2026?


**[Diwali, the Festival of Lights, falls on November 8, 2026](https://www.remitly.com/blog/lifestyle-culture/celebrating-diwali/)** . Dhanteras, which kicks off the five-day Diwali celebration, lands two days earlier on **November 6, 2026** .


While the main event happens in early November, the lead-up starts much sooner. Families in the United States who want to send gifts, arrange travel, or transfer money to relatives in India typically begin preparations in the **last week of October** . Retailers see a spike in demand, flights fill up faster, and international money transfers surge as people get ready for the celebrations.


If you’re planning to be part of this year’s festivities from abroad, late October is the window to start organizing everything—not the first week of November.


## Why Is Dhanteras Considered the Most Auspicious Day to Buy Gold?


Dhanteras holds a special place in Diwali traditions. The name combines “Dhan” (wealth) and “Teras” (the thirteenth day), and it’s widely regarded as the most favorable day of the year to purchase gold, silver, and other valuables.


According to tradition, buying precious metals or new household items on Dhanteras invites prosperity and good fortune into the home for the year ahead. This belief drives significant consumer activity: gold and jewelry sales in India consistently spike in the days surrounding Dhanteras, making it one of the busiest shopping periods on the Indian calendar.


For families abroad, this often means sending extra funds home around this time, whether to contribute toward a relative’s gold purchase or to support broader household celebrations.


## How Does the Diwali Season Affect Travel and Shopping Plans?


Diwali is as much about togetherness as it is about tradition. Many people living in the United States plan trips to India during this period to reunite with family, which means flight bookings often need to be locked in well before the holiday itself.


At the same time, gift-giving is a major part of Diwali customs. Sweets, clothing, electronics, and jewelry are common gifts exchanged among family and friends. This combination of travel planning and gift shopping is exactly why the shopping and money-sending season for Diwali begins so far in advance of the actual date.


If travel or shopping plans depend on funds arriving in India, timing becomes especially important. This is where understanding bank schedules around the holiday matters.


## Are Indian Banks Open During Dhanteras?


This is one of the most practical questions for anyone planning to send money to India around this time of year. Diwali is a **public holiday in India** , and banks are typically closed on the main Diwali date. Depending on the state and the specific bank, hours may also be reduced or branches closed on Dhanteras and the days surrounding it.


Because bank holidays can vary by region and are sometimes confirmed closer to the date, it’s difficult to rely on same-day processing for transfers made right before or during the holiday. A transfer initiated on November 6 or 7 may not be processed until banks reopen, which could mean delays exactly when funds are needed most—for gold purchases, gifts, or family celebrations.


## When Should You Send Money to India Before Dhanteras 2026?


The safest approach is simple: send money before the last week of October if it needs to be available by Dhanteras or Diwali. This gives enough buffer for standard processing times and avoids the risk of holiday-related delays at Indian banks.


A few practical points to keep in mind when planning transfers around this time:


- **Confirm your recipient’s bank details in advance.** Errors in account numbers or bank codes can cause delays that are harder to fix during a holiday period.
- **Account for weekends and regional holidays.** Diwali-related closures can vary by state, and some banks may observe additional days off around the festival.
- **Send earlier rather than later.** If gold buying on Dhanteras or Diwali celebrations depend on the funds, aim to complete your transfer at least a few days before November 6.


Planning your transfer with this timeline in mind means one less thing to worry about during a season that’s meant to be about celebration, not logistics.


## Start Planning Your Dhanteras 2026 Transfers Early


Diwali is a time for connection, tradition, and generosity, and for many families in the United States, that includes sending support home to loved ones in India. Knowing the key dates, understanding why Dhanteras carries such significance, and planning around Indian bank schedules can help you avoid unnecessary stress as the festival approaches.


The most important takeaway is timing. With Dhanteras falling on November 6 and Diwali on November 8 in 2026, the smartest move is to have your money transfers, gifts, and travel plans sorted out well before the last week of October arrives.


## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)


### When is Dhanteras in 2026?


Dhanteras falls on November 6, 2026, two days before the main Diwali celebration.


### When is Diwali in 2026?


Diwali is celebrated on November 8, 2026.


### Why do people buy gold on Dhanteras?


Dhanteras is considered the most auspicious day of the year in Indian tradition to buy gold, silver, and household items, as it’s believed to bring prosperity and good fortune for the year ahead.


### Are banks in India closed for Diwali?


Yes, Diwali is a public holiday in India, and banks are typically closed on the main holiday. Hours may also be reduced or branches closed around Dhanteras and other days in the festival period, though this can vary by state and bank.


### When should I send money to India before Diwali?


To avoid delays caused by holiday closures, it’s best to send money before the last week of October so funds have time to arrive ahead of Dhanteras and Diwali.
